items.question: What are the normal working hours per day in the UAE private sector under the UAE Labour Law?
items.fact: UAE private sector normal working hours: 8 per day.

items.question: Under UAE private sector labour rules, how many extra overtime hours can an employer ask a worker to work in one day?
items.gold: No more than two hours in one day.
items.fact: Overtime limited to two extra hours per day in private sector.
